ctx.x: Well, you said that jazz didn't offend you. Did you, you know, did a lot of people say

the thing, it was just rotten gutter, claptrap, claptrap? A lot of people did. And I wouldn't doubt for a moment that I went through a period in which I felt that. But I mean the overall feeling that I have now is that it didn't offend me and that it doesn't offend me. Although I would never go out and seek it. What about Alvin? Keep quiet. I never would go out and seek it as a form of entertainment. And when I, I've always under certain conditions, loved Papa Celestan for example. And when the saints go marching…
And you said a great number of people that did? I think there were, I think there were many that did. Would you say a majority of New Orleans?
